Knocks out the deranged lantern servant nonlethally and loots his lantern and keys
2022-12-18 @ 01:56:11–02:01:03.
Escapes into the Ethereal Plane to survive the burning gas-trap room
2022-12-26 @ 01:19:14.
Braves the active fire trap to claim a shapeshifting magic sword, later identified as the
Sun Sword’s blade 2022-12-26 @ 03:58:19–03:59:58.
Knocks out a chained goblin accountant with a neck chop
2023-01-30 @ 00:22:31.
Co-invents “piss coat” with Todd to bend warded bars using a urine-soaked hide
2023-01-30 @ 04:25:30.
Dropped to -17 HP by a domination-forced sneak attack from Jess’s character; saved only by the party
burning its last two Fate Points on a reroll
2023-02-12 @ 01:20:30–01:30:46.
Lands two flaming Hurricane Kicks on Strahd, damaging him even in mist form
2023-02-12 @ 02:10:47, @ 02:22:21.
Takes heavy Constitution damage from golem poison breath but helps finish off both golems with
elemental-infused strikes 2023-03-12 @ 01:42:55, @ 02:12:36.
Is dominated by Donovan during his reveal as a traitor, and pulls a hot gem from a demon’s
corpse, swallows it, then vomits it back up after hearing whispers from it
2023-03-18.
Weighs Lightning Reflexes against Combat Reflexes on leveling up to 7th
2023-03-18 @ 00:38:38.

Unresolved
Whether “Woo-woo”/“Wu” and “JB” are both genuine in-fiction nicknames for Jacques, or the result of
transcription drift across sessions, is unclear — by the mistform session, “Woo” is instead applied to
Ozan’s character, raising the possibility of a mid-campaign nickname swap or
transcription confusion between the two players’ characters
2023-02-12.

pcs/jess's-witch.title: Jess's Witch
pcs/jess's-witch.content:
Jess’s witch, owner of a ferret familiar (Enfield) and later of the folding boat “Nessie”; revealed in
session 5 to be a changeling rather than human. Never given a real character name on mic.
History

Introduced as a witch with a ferret familiar, Enfield; a whimsy-table roll gives her a folding boat,
and a separate roll turns her into a weasel for the session
2023-09-12 @ 01:57:49, @ 02:20:35.
Casts Deep Slumber, putting enemies to sleep; jokingly nicknamed “Volvo Morton” by Pat (a pun on her
Discord handle); logs off mid-combat, tired, needing to be up for work at dawn
2023-10-01 @ 01:03:33, @ 01:04:53, @ 03:26:10.
Rolls a 30 (not a natural 20, despite Jake’s assumption) identifying the drained
soul device as plane-crossing; names her folding boat “Nessie” and summons it in its
full ship form (cabin, holds 15); revealed as a changeling
2023-10-24 @ 00:21:49–00:22:07, @ 00:43:45–00:44:41,
@ 00:46:17.
Curses carpet-maker Greg to compulsively count every board in his shop after a sponsorship deal
collapses 2023-10-24 @ 03:15:01–03:18:00.
Not listed in the session 6 party.

Unresolved
Her character’s real name is never given; “Volvo Morton” is a joke nickname, not a stated in-fiction
name.

pcs/jim-jones.title: Jim Jones
pcs/jim-jones.content:
Connor’s human Oracle, afflicted with the Covetous curse (must wear 500gp+ of finery). “Jim Jones” is a
table nickname for the character’s cult-leader-flavored curse flavor, not a stated character name — his
real name is never given.
History

Introduced as a Heaven’s Oracle with the Covetous curse; this is his first time playing D&D, per the
table 2023-09-12 @ 01:39:48, @ 03:35:51.
Casts a memory-lapse spell on a guard who’d learned Mary’s location, wiping the last five minutes of
his memory and triggering it when he drops a coin
2023-09-12 @ 03:36:31–03:36:52.
Seen after the heist outside the bank handing out pamphlets with a falafel, apparently recruiting for a
cult 2023-10-01 @ 03:33:45.
Opens the doppelganger ambush with a surprise-round Hypnotic Pattern boosted by his Awesome Display
revelation; caught in the blast radius of Pat’s own fire spell; escapes the firestorm by swimming a
canal with a water-breathing spell 2023-10-15 @ 00:05:02,
@ 00:21:51, @ 01:29:43.
Present in session 5 with no race/class restated.
As an unnamed, lawful-evil cursed Oracle with a +1 chainmail attuned to an “ocular mystery” revelation,
present throughout session 6 without a distinguishing scene
2023-11-28 @ 00:52:30, @ 00:56:35.

Unresolved
His actual character name is never stated in any session; “Jim Jones” is purely a table joke about his
Covetous-curse flavor.

pcs/kurt-furbane.title: Kurt Furbane
pcs/kurt-furbane.content:
Ozan’s Arc I character, a bard from the plane of Nirvana who teleports aboard the party’s ship and talks
his way into joining the crew. A character also called “Kurt Furbank,” with a different player and class,
appears later in the arc — see Unresolved.
History

Teleports aboard the ship via dimension door, nearly gets attacked by Nutty’s character, and joins the
crew after a charming bardic performance
2020-01-28 @ 00:17:59–02:10:34.
Ozan’s character — unnamed on-mic, a bard-like fey being with moth-like wings — performs music for
party buffs during the church-demon fight 2020-04-13
@ 00:11:46, @ 02:37:47.

Unresolved
A character named “Kurt Furbank,” played by Nutty and described as a rogue/sneak-attack type with magic
flying armor, lands the finishing blow on the glabrezu demon in
2020-04-13 @ 03:35:05. Whether this is the same character
(recast or misattributed in the notes) or an unrelated character who happens to share a near-identical
name is not resolved in the transcripts.

pcs/miss-cleo.title: Miss Cleo
pcs/miss-cleo.content:
Ozan’s Arc II character, a psychic/bard-type with telepathy, memory-sharing, stoneskin, and buff/support
spells.
History

Shares two childhood memories with Alexander via psychic link to help him answer the Sphinx’s first
riddle 2021-10-19 @ 00:41:50.
Touches the riddle pad herself and nearly dies (dropped to 2 HP) botching the second riddle twice before
Nutty works out the answer 2021-10-19 @ 01:00:36–01:30:00.
Tells a stranger’s fortune at a town festival, has a true psychic vision of her murder that night, and
geases the woman’s companion instead of warning her directly
2021-10-19 @ 01:46:06–01:50:02.
Stays behind at the one-way portal with the now-sentient Sphinx Painting rather than step through
2021-10-19 @ 03:02:21.
Rolls the highest initiative (23) of the frost giant fight and buffs the party with stoneskin
2021-11-02 @ 00:05:25, @ 00:15:11.
Uses hideous laughter to leave the mimic prone and cackling before Rich kills it
2021-11-02 @ 01:54:17.

Unresolved
Whether Ozan’s vision of the fortune-telling woman’s murder was ever acted on further is not shown; the
outcome of the geas he placed on her companion is never revealed.

pcs/mori-yoshinari.title: Mori Yoshinari
pcs/mori-yoshinari.content:
Donnie’s Arc I character: the party’s ship captain, bonded to the ship’s enslaved air elemental, wanted
by the Church of St. Cuthbert. Named “Mori Yoshinari” from
2020-01-28 onward; earlier sessions call him only “Donovan” or
“Donnie’s character,” with inconsistent class descriptions (Sword Saint samurai in the first recorded
session, a cleric-type with Use Magic Device by the time he becomes captain) — treated here as one
continuous character, with the discrepancy flagged below.
History

As a Sword Saint (samurai), lawful evil, uses iaijutsu strikes and survives near-death via Resolve and
fate points 2019-10-15 @ 01:56:31–02:00:47.
Finds the dead mage’s journal of planar cosmology aboard the looted ship
2020-01-20 @ 00:20:38.
Touches the ship’s planar crystal directly, triggering an accidental plane shift
2020-01-20 @ 01:02:51.
Speaks the command word “Pop Jack,” permanently bonding with the ship’s air elemental; elected the
party’s Captain 2020-01-20 @ 02:33:57, @ 02:40:23.
Named “Mori Yoshinari” for the first time; revealed to be wanted by the Church of St. Cuthbert for a
stolen/destroyed boat 2020-01-28 @ 00:52:22.
Commissions mithril +3 “Eastern” armor and an enchanted katana in Neo
2020-01-28 @ 01:24:28–01:35:43.
Reveals the lore on how the Apocalypse Box can be destroyed (three survived monster-waves, then a
gold dragon crushing it) 2020-03-16 @ 00:44:54.
Straps drow bodies to the ship’s bloodletting tables to refuel it after escaping Hell
2020-03-25 @ 00:55:49.
Pilots the ship’s interplanar jump that accidentally lands the party in the Feywild instead of home
2020-03-25 @ 02:31:40–02:36:13.
Turned to stone by a basilisk and remains petrified for the entire session
2020-04-06 @ 00:24:06.
Fights in mithril plate with his katana in the temple battle against the glabrezu demon
2020-04-13 @ 03:08:50.

Unresolved
His class/fluff shifts across sessions — Sword Saint samurai, then a cleric-type with Use Magic Device,
then described again as a “samurai/fighter type” — without any in-game explanation; likely imprecise
session notes rather than an in-fiction change. It is unclear whether this is the same character Donnie
plays in the 2021 sessions as Fish, or a new character rolled after an off-screen gap.

pcs/nutty's-arcane-combatant-(dungeonvic.title: Nutty's Arcane Combatant (DungeonVice)
pcs/nutty's-arcane-combatant-(dungeonvic.content:
Nutty’s character in the DungeonVice campaign: an arcane combatant wielding a bladed tail weapon (treated
as a scimitar), casting Web and a touch-spell/weapon combo nicknamed “Washashaka” (also heard as
“Walshashah”). Speaks Common, Elven, Dwarf, Draconic, and Abyssal. Never named on mic in session 3.
History

Fights in the warehouse blind-crossfire alongside Ozone after Glitter Dust drops the guards
2025-03-31 @ 01:15:07.
Reminded by Jake of two forgotten magic items: the tail weapon and Ozone’s “Whoop Whoop” whistle
2025-03-31 @ 01:28:59.
Catches up to Rich downstairs and, flanking with him, finishes off Fugly with a combined
weapon-and-shocking-grasp strike (“Washashaka”) 2025-03-31
@ 02:46:05-02:48:22.
Gives Ozone a Ring of Protection +1 after the party levels up
2025-03-31 @ 03:19:55.

Unresolved
No proper name was given on mic for this character in session 3; the “Washashaka”/“Walshashah” ability
name is likely a mangled homebrew term 2025-03-31 @ 02:46:05, @ 02:46:46.

pcs/nutty's-healer-(arc-i).title: Nutty's Healer (Arc I)
pcs/nutty's-healer-(arc-i).content:
Nutty’s Arc I character, an alchemist/healer whose body is unknowingly possessed by a demon for several
sessions after Nutty touches a cursed soul gem — a secret even Nutty’s own player hadn’t fully known until
it was revealed in-game.
History

Identifies the Ring of the Hive Mind with a natural 20 Knowledge: Arcana check
2020-01-20 @ 00:03:52.
Unknowingly possessed by a demon from a touched soul gem sometime before this session’s events are
recapped 2020-03-24 @ 02:43:50.
As the possessing demon, kills Ozan’s character and then the unconscious Tick-Tick
2020-03-24 @ 01:59:28, @ 02:22:31.
The demon is banished by the newly-reborn Paladin of Pelor; Nutty wakes disoriented, describing himself
as “an empty vessel” 2020-03-24 @ 02:50:25.
Soul restored to his body via the recovered soul gem after roughly a day and a half trapped inside it
2020-03-25 @ 00:42:10–00:44:47.
Opens the side door that leads to finding Obadiah Jones frozen in ice
2020-04-06 @ 00:49:11.

Unresolved
This character’s name is never stated in the recorded sessions.

pcs/obadiah-jones.title: Obadiah Jones
pcs/obadiah-jones.content:
A Loxodon cleric, chaotic good, found frozen in ice by the party and freed mid-session; joins the party as
a new PC played by Ryan, a new player this session.
Summary
Obadiah had come looking for an ancient church tied to his unnamed deity alongside an adventuring party of
fellow loxodons, all of whom starved to death around him while he was frozen. He has no memory of how he
ended up sealed in ice.
History

Found frozen in a stone dais, elephant-headed, inside a man-sized block of ice beside his dead former
party’s skeletons 2020-04-06 @ 00:49:11.
Freed when Rich’s summoned fire elementals finally melt the ice; wakes disoriented, cold, and covered in
urine from the party’s earlier attempts to thaw him
2020-04-06 @ 01:45:29.
Casts Terrible Remorse on the demon holding Jake, staggering it for a round
2020-04-06 @ 02:05:59.
Fights in the temple battle against the glabrezu demon, falling back to support casting when his
offensive spells keep fizzling against its spell resistance
2020-04-13 @ 00:48:37 (ceremony/aftermath context).

Unresolved
His deity’s name and the “ancient church” he was seeking are never established in the recorded sessions.

pcs/ozan's-alchemist.title: Ozan's Alchemist
pcs/ozan's-alchemist.content:
An alchemist/investigator-type character played by Ozan — AC 22, mithril shirt, thieves’ tools, low
Strength and high Dexterity. Handles most of the party’s perception, lockpicking, and disable-device
checks, brews and shares potions via “alchemical allocation,” and uses tanglefoot bags and Poison Lore in
a fight. The character’s name is never consistently stated; see Unresolved.
History

Fails to pick the dining hall’s locked bronze door, then buffs Ulumbra with an alchemical
“ablative barrier” extract 2022-12-18
@ 00:37:42, @ 01:14:41.
Spots the magical glow and gold piles across the flooded dungeon’s cells, then triggers a hidden poison
gas mechanism while looting them
2022-12-26 @ 00:38:55, @ 01:15:42.
Picks the final lock to free Jess’s character from a burning cell
2022-12-26 @ 03:53:00.
Frees the prisoner Murph, who immediately re-triggers a teleport trap
2022-12-26 @ 03:04:37–03:07:18.
Loots the Vonderbux family signet ring from an empty crypt in the catacombs
2023-01-30 @ 02:18:27.
Resists Strahd’s domination gaze alongside Xarthax during the boss fight
2023-02-12 @ 01:00:30.
Fails a save prying open Strahd’s coffin with a shield and turns to stone, restored by Xarthax’s Dispel
Magic 2023-02-12 @ 00:30:57–00:36:18.
Spots the riddle on the hourglass trap and disarms the golden chest’s trap
2023-03-12 @ 00:24:30–00:34:48.
Feeds Todd a Barkskin potion mid-fight and burns a Fate Point to keep Alumbra conscious after her
critical fumble between the two golems 2023-03-12 @ 01:17:30, @ 01:37:45.
Identifies the golems’ poison via Poison Lore and brews an antidote overnight, curing Wu and Alumbra
2023-03-12 @ 02:35:17–02:38:36.
Absent from the next two sessions; his potions are used remotely by the party as an NPC healing source
2023-03-18 @ 00:15:32.

Unresolved
The character’s name is never consistently stated: heard across sessions as “Zendrick,” “Lobel,” and
“Nadi”/“Nadia.” By the mistform session, he is also addressed as “Woo”/“Wubu Tang” — the same nickname
used for Jake’s monk character in earlier sessions, raising the possibility of a
nickname swap or transcription confusion between the two players’ characters
2023-02-12.

pcs/ozone.title: Ozone
pcs/ozone.content:
Ozan’s bard-type character in the DungeonVice campaign, going by the disguised alias “Mr. Vajidkas” (“from
Kazakhstan”) during the dockworker con. Uses a disguise kit/hat of disguise, a net as signature weapon, an
oratory bardic performance (“Pirate’s Courage”), Glitter Dust, Knowledge (religion), and channels positive
energy to heal. Speaks Common and Goblin.
History

Flirts his way into the confidence of the captured prisoner, Riggs’s Widow, learning about
Riggs, the Golden Ticket to the Devil, and the College of Turgeth Drug Pipeline
2025-03-31 @ 00:15:20-00:24:08.
Poses as “Mr. Vajidkas” to befriend drunk dockworker Dex, trading moonshine and cocaine for intel,
before Dex reveals himself as a lookout 2025-03-31 @ 00:56:49-01:05:14.
Casts Glitter Dust, blinding the warehouse guards; blinded, they miss their shots (one hits a wall, one
grazes an ally) and the party cuts them down on attacks of opportunity as they flail and flee
2025-03-31 @ 01:15:07-01:20:04.
Reminded of his forgotten “Whoop Whoop” whistle item 2025-03-31 @ 01:28:59.
Heals himself and the party with Channel Positive Energy and looted potions
2025-03-31 @ 03:03:51-03:06:27.
Torches the warehouse with a tossed cigarette as he and Nutty retreat
2025-03-31 @ 03:13:57-03:14:24.
Receives a Ring of Protection +1 from Nutty’s Arcane Combatant (DungeonVice)
2025-03-31 @ 03:19:55.

pcs/pat's-wizard-(dungeonvice).title: Pat's Wizard (DungeonVice)
pcs/pat's-wizard-(dungeonvice).content:
Pat’s character in the DungeonVice campaign: a wizard. Not to be confused with Pat’s Wizard from
JakeDM’s 2023 campaign — a different character in a different campaign. Pat was away for nearly all of
session 3, so little is known about this character yet.
History

Casts Mage Armor on Rich’s Monk (DungeonVice) before the mission, then is AFK/absent for nearly the
entire session, acting as lookout 2025-03-31 @ 00:48:40, @ 02:14:35.
Returns to find the party already leveled up without him; will level up a session behind the others
2025-03-31 @ 03:18:05, @ 03:18:18.

Unresolved
No proper name, race, or further build detail was given on mic in session 3, since Pat was absent for
almost the whole session.

pcs/pat's-wizard.title: Pat's Wizard
pcs/pat's-wizard.content:
Pat’s main-arc character: a tiefling with a prehensile tail, a wood-mage wizard who later also casts
spells described as sorcerous. Never named on mic across any of the five main-arc sessions.
History

Introduced as a tiefling wood mage/wizard; uses the Wand of Memory Lapse on Mary twice to erase
an awkward encounter at her door, and later again after Connor insults her; conjures a wooden stick and
throws it at an attacking goblin family, accidentally killing the goblin father when he falls off a
balcony 2023-09-12 @ 02:56:41, @ 03:06:06,
@ 03:24:07, @ 03:43:33.
Flies the heist’s loot chest to the bank roof and loots it into a bag of holding
2023-10-01 @ 02:42:00–03:57:41.
Casts the new spell Cicero/Sirocco, a furnace-hot blast that triggers the Dyson Dynamo’s citywide
firestorm; flies Ozan out of the blaze; sets up a refugee triage camp afterward
2023-10-15 @ 00:21:51, @ 01:30:03, @ 01:49:39.
Fails to buy the spell Skeleton Crew from a refugee wizard; scries on Cadillac for seven minutes; casts
Fly on the party’s boat and hands control to his familiar, a luck dragon named Randy; trips a magical
Alarm sneaking disguised into Lutathal 2023-10-24
@ 00:38:18, @ 00:49:09–00:54:54, @ 01:08:23, @ 01:38:37.
Casts the “Neuralizer” memory-lapse spell on a TIU investigator mid-interrogation; later
intimidates/bluffs a carpet shopkeeper out of a discarded firework carpet and Neuralizes him too, to
cover up admitting the carpet will be raced
2023-11-28 @ 00:46:48, @ 01:52:22–01:56:28.

Unresolved
Described as a wizard (wood-mage specialist) in sessions 1, 2, and 4, but as a “sorcerer” with an
improved familiar in session 5 — never explained on-mic whether this is a class change, multiclass, or
just loose terminology. His character name is never stated in any session.

pcs/raven.title: Raven
pcs/raven.content:
A human witch, roughly 50 years old and twice divorced, with a familiar zoog that prefers eating sentient
beings. Casts hexes (Misfortune, Cackle, Ear-Piercing Scream, Evil Eye), Cure Light Wounds, Fly, Remove
Curse, and Air Bubble. Dies partway through the campaign and rises as Strahd’s
vampire thrall under the name Donovan, ultimately betraying the party before being lost to the Astral
Plane.
History

Introduced as a human witch with a sentient-being-eating zoog familiar
2022-12-06 @ 00:46:55.
Casts Remove Curse on Irina with no effect
2022-12-06 @ 03:08:25.
Accidentally splashes Madame Eva with holy water, ending the tarot reading early
2022-12-06 @ 04:00:19.
Rejoins the party partway through the dinner session; casts Remove Curse to cure the familiar’s
cauldron-induced brain-craving 2022-12-18
@ 01:46:49, @ 02:08:49.
Pickpockets a chained bookkeeper for 333 gold undetected
2022-12-26 @ 04:22:30.
Flies down a 400+ foot shaft to scout the catacombs, then ferries party members down one at a time
2023-01-30 @ 01:54:00.
Splashes holy water on Sergei von Zarovich’s body, triggering a mind-link that reveals Strahd’s
murder of Sergei and Tatiana 2023-01-30 @ 04:00:19.
Chasing a lost familiar, crashes into the warded bars guarding Strahd’s coffin, is fatally drained, dies,
and rises on the spot as a chaotic-evil vampire thrall
2023-01-30 @ 04:56:54–05:19:31.
As “Donovan,” wins initiative and flees the party as mist through a gap near the ceiling, along with his
zoog 2023-02-12 @ 00:03:28–00:10:31.
Revealed to have secretly been serving Strahd the whole time, ambushing the party from a dark bedroom;
dominates Jake and summons a delayed pack of wolves
2023-03-18 @ 00:48:16 onward.
Dropped to 0 HP and turns to vampire mist; stuffed into Jess’s handy haversack for
containment 2023-03-18.
Flung into the Astral Plane when Todd accidentally destroys the haversack trying to free
him; given two hours to find a resting place or be destroyed forever — fate never resolved on-screen
2023-03-18.

Unresolved

The character’s real name is never cleanly stated — “Raven” is used before the vampirization, “Donovan”
afterward, and the DM calls her “Johnny”/“Jonathan” at least once, possibly a running joke rather than a
real name 2023-01-30 @ 03:39:55, @ 05:16:39.
Donovan’s fate after being flung into the Astral Plane is never shown or mentioned again in the recorded
sessions.

pcs/rich's-monk-(dungeonvice).title: Rich's Monk (DungeonVice)
pcs/rich's-monk-(dungeonvice).content:
Rich’s character in the DungeonVice campaign: a monk fighting with Crane Style, Stunning Strike, and
flurry of blows. Never named on mic in session 3. Carries the party’s shared platinum piece in his handy
haversack.
History

Mage-Armored by Pat’s Wizard (DungeonVice) before the mission; carries the party’s platinum piece
in his handy haversack 2025-03-31 @ 00:48:40, @ 00:51:08.
Punches open the warehouse door under fire to start the raid
2025-03-31 @ 01:08:22.
Sprints ahead alone toward a signal flare, runs past Fugly rather than stopping to fight, then
doubles back; Fugly follows him downstairs and nearly drops him with a 36-damage critical hit, before
Nutty arrives, flanks Fugly, and finishes him off — Rich then loots his Boots of Haste
2025-03-31 @ 01:37:48-02:49:34.
Activates the boots and turns ethereal, flies after the departing ship and spots The Boot himself,
unnoticed, ending the session mid-chase 2025-03-31 @ 02:58:23-03:02:43,
@ 03:09:40-03:10:13.

Unresolved
No proper name was given on mic for this character in session 3.

pcs/richard-findelberg.title: Richard Findelberg
pcs/richard-findelberg.content:
Rich’s android wizard/crafter/blaster sorcerer, immune to fatigue, exhaustion, and fear. Surname
“Findelberg” is given once, in session 5.
History

Introduced woken near a pile of bodies outside a snowy castle; no spellbook
2023-09-12 @ 03:13:10–03:14:15.
Repeatedly casts Lightning Bolt and Fireball during the vault brawl; casts Blind on Cadillac, who shrugs
it off with a successful save; wins a Broom of Flying on a roll-off meant for the absent Jess
2023-10-01 @ 00:54:01, @ 01:22:41, @ 03:28:22–03:36:35,
@ 04:27:03–04:27:29.
Casts Haste on the party; Dimension Doors the absent NPCs clear of the burning city; crafts his
Headband of Intellect up to +4, which comes with a haunted “eye” showing visions of the fire
2023-10-15 @ 00:27:11, @ 01:07:58, @ 02:03:00.
Confirms he still has his silver scrying mirror, lent to Pat to spy on Cadillac; crafts extra sleeves
of many garments overnight for the party
2023-10-24 @ 00:24:36, @ 00:56:19–01:00:01.
Absent from session 6; per the session’s recap, bartered into indentured “robot servant” service to
a rug shop by Frankie rather than pay for a carpet
2023-11-28 @ 00:12:38–00:13:23.

Unresolved
His character’s full name (“Richard Findelberg”) is only given once, in session 5 — earlier sessions use
only “Richard” or “Rich’s character.”

pcs/sarkhan-vol.title: Sarkhan Vol
pcs/sarkhan-vol.content:
A human transmutation wizard, former combat mage for Hawthorne’s war effort who worships a dragon god and
keeps a fairy dragon familiar. Appears only in the interlude session DM’d by Pat; see
2023-10-08 and jakedm Unresolved for
this session’s disconnect from the rest of the campaign.
History

Teleports roughly 1,300 miles to Hawthorne in answer to Jace Gandolfini’s summons
2023-10-08 @ 01:03:49.
Shares an identical dream with Jace and accepts a Revelation Crystal from a skeleton child, waking with
a brand @ 01:56:37–01:58:19.
Uses his Revelation Crystal to dispel the cursed map’s illusion, revealing the route to the Tomb of
Horrors @ 02:01:41.
Buys and copies scrolls of Concealed Breath and Dispel Magic as backup against the Isle of Death’s
miasma @ 03:02:11–03:10:40.

Unresolved
His nickname is transcribed inconsistently as “Con,” “Khan,” “Kavík,” and “Kansvæin”; “Sarkhan Vol” is
used here on the strength of an explicit Magic: The Gathering reference at the table
2023-10-08 @ 02:04:11–02:04:26. No later session
returns to this character.

pcs/seabreeze.title: Seabreeze
pcs/seabreeze.content:
Nutty’s character: a Strix (“birdman”) fighter/archer. Named “Rick, aka Seabreeze” in session 2.
History

Introduced as a Strix fighter/archer 2023-09-12
@ 03:13:43.
Named “Rick, aka Seabreeze”; dogfights and shoots down an enemy druid NPC who wild-shaped into a crow
(the “Druid” is the enemy, not Seabreeze’s own class) 2023-10-01
@ 03:06:08, @ 03:31:06.
Flies up and shoots dead the doppelganger carrying the Dyson Dynamo
2023-10-15 @ 00:36:05.
Signs into Lutathal under the joke alias “Bertha” 2023-10-24
@ 03:29:18.
Not listed in the session 6 party.

Unresolved
None outstanding — the apparent “Druid” discrepancy in session 2 was an enemy NPC druid (killed by
Seabreeze mid-dogfight), not Seabreeze’s own class.

pcs/tick-tick.title: Tick-Tick
pcs/tick-tick.content:
Jake’s Arc I character: an elf druid who became the cursed, compelled bearer of the Apocalypse Box,
died, and was reborn a Paladin of Pelor. Likely (though not explicitly confirmed) the same character as
the unnamed divine shapeshifter Jake plays starting 2020-01-20
— the name “Tick-Tick” only appears starting the Apocalypse Box arc.
History

As an unnamed divine caster, shapeshifts into a bird/falcon and carries an immovable rod
2020-01-20 @ 01:56:05.
Shapechanged into falcon/bat forms exploring Spider Heaven with an Allosaurus companion
2020-03-16 @ 00:34:16.
Fails a DC 30 will save on the newly-appeared Apocalypse Box and is magically compelled to seize
and guard it by any means, including violence against friends
2020-03-16 @ 00:22:04.
Flees with the box to the ship; opens it under the Apocalypse Box’s curse, risking Shoggoth summons
each day 2020-03-16 @ 00:40:06.
Named “Tick-Tick” for the first time; the party debates killing him to stop the box’s eventual
destruction of the plane 2020-03-24 @ 00:30:49.
Loses 40%+ of his blood volume bleeding the ship’s engine, goes into cardiac arrest, and is later killed
by the demon possessing Nutty while unconscious
2020-03-24 @ 00:58:36, @ 02:22:31.
Dies and, with his final breath, communes with Pelor; his body dissolves and reforms as an armored
Paladin of Pelor wielding a golden scythe, free of the Apocalypse Box’s curse
2020-03-24 @ 02:38:22.
As the new Paladin, banishes the demon possessing Nutty with his holy symbol
2020-03-24 @ 02:42:10.
Heals Nutty with Lay on Hands after his soul is restored to his body
2020-03-25 @ 00:20:28 (approx., following soul restoration).
Lands a critical smite on the soul-sucking demon in the puzzle room
2020-03-25 @ 01:23:56.
Grappled, dragged into the Ethereal Plane by a demon, and strength-drained to 0 and unconscious
2020-04-06 @ 01:31:42–01:59:08.
Back and active by the next session; gets forcibly thrown out of a knighting ceremony over a joke and
challenged to a duel to the death 2020-04-13 @ 01:43:28.
Fires a smiting arrow into the glabrezu demon during the temple fight
2020-04-13 @ 03:16:05.

Unresolved
The mechanism by which the party recovered Tick-Tick from the Ethereal Plane between sessions is never
shown on-screen. His duel to the death, scheduled for the morning after
2020-04-13, is interrupted by the demon fight and never
revisited in the recorded sessions.

pcs/todd-stone.title: Todd Stone
pcs/todd-stone.content:
A human fighter who fights with two spike shields, carries the party’s torches, and has no darkvision.
The most consistently-named and stable PC across the whole Ravenloft campaign; AC climbs to 24+ (26
fighting defensively, higher still with buffs) by the later sessions.
History

Introduced carrying two spike shields at the roadside inn
2022-12-06 @ 00:16:20.
Learns from Madame Eva’s tarot vision that he does not die to a vampire, but chokes on a sausage
decades later 2022-12-06 @ 03:45:11.
Bumps a suit of armor with someone breathing inside it, interrupting Strahd’s organ music
2022-12-18 @ 00:31:45.
Sets the Strahd decoy mannequin on fire, then critically fumbles a thrown shield into his own face and
stuns himself 2022-12-18 @ 00:53:45, @ 01:29:07.
Falls through a trap door into the flooded lower dungeon and finds a gold-filled treasure chest
2022-12-18 @ 02:22:33–02:31:28.
Trapped at the bottom of a hundred-foot funnel shaft with Ozan’s character, across from gold-filled
cells 2022-12-26 @ 00:34:37.
Ignites a poison gas trap by throwing a lit torch into it to test flammability, starting a fire that
burns for the rest of the session
2022-12-26 @ 01:17:44–01:18:21.
Spends many rounds breaking down a reinforced door to free the prisoner Murph
2022-12-26 @ 02:58:23–03:03:16.
Tanks at the top of a stairwell against two golems, dropping a looted chest mid-flight to survive
2023-03-12 @ 00:59:51–01:00:50.
Trying to help free Donovan’s mist form from a handy haversack, destroys the haversack
instead, tearing open a gate to the Astral Plane
2023-03-18 @ 00:21:03–00:24:21
(approximate).
Finds a previously-rescued prisoner dead, eyes removed, and presses on alone toward a tower with a
pulsing red glass “heart” as the session ends
2023-03-18 @ end of session.
Continues exploring the upper dungeon alone while the rest of the party rests at low HP, avoiding a
spiderweb-filled room and fixating on the pulsating red light
2023-03-18 @ 00:02:46–00:03:14.

Unresolved
Todd’s class/build is mostly inferred from play (shields, Strength, tanking) rather than ever stated
outright on-mic 2023-03-12.

pcs/xarthax.title: Xarthax
pcs/xarthax.content:
An android arcane caster — doesn’t eat, doesn’t sleep, immune to necrotic damage, fear, aging, and
mind-affecting effects (having no flesh or mind to affect in the usual sense). Casts Mage Armor, Shield,
Shocking Grasp, Mirror Image, Dispel Magic, Fly, Fireball, and Magic Missile, among others. Carries gloves
of reconnaissance that let him see five feet through solid material.
History

Casts Fly to rejoin the party in the flooded dungeon
2022-12-18 @ 02:35:40.
Fireball wipes most of a ten-skeleton ambush in the rotting cell corridor
2022-12-18 @ 01:19:21–01:22:17.
Identifies the Tome of Strahd via Knowledge (History)
2022-12-18 @ 02:12:35.
Flies into the burning gas-trap room to rescue party members
2022-12-26 @ 01:37:34–01:48:02.
Identifies Jake’s shapeshifting sword as the Sun Sword via Spellcraft
2023-01-30 @ 04:10:16.
Resists Strahd’s domination gaze and opens the boss fight with a fireball
2023-02-12 @ 01:00:30, @ 01:05:52.
Restores Woo from petrification with Dispel Magic after Woo fails a save prying
open Strahd’s coffin 2023-02-12 @ 00:34:21–00:36:18.
Blasts open a DC 40 locked door with a scroll of Knock (rolling 43) right as the room’s two iron golems
animate 2023-03-12 @ 00:44:19.
Finishes off the second iron golem with Magic Missile
2023-03-12 @ 02:29:01.
Tanks the servants’-dining-hall ghost ambush almost single-handedly, being immune to the ghosts’ aging
and fear/mind effects — the table later concludes this immunity was the only thing stopping a total
party wipe 2023-03-18,
2023-03-18 @ 00:56:44–00:57:14.
Weighs 4th-level wizard spell picks (Stoneskin, Dimension Door, Ball Lightning, Permanency) on leveling
up to 7th 2023-03-18 @ 00:40:48–01:04:00.

Unresolved
Xarthax’s proper name is never stated on mic in several sessions, and session 1 instead describes “Rich’s
character” as an unnamed drow bard carrying the Aegis of Recovery, with a separate absent “Jeff’s
character” as a mage-type carrying the Scabbard of Keen Edges. Whether Xarthax (who first appears by name
in session 2) is meant to be a continuation of either of those session-1 characters, or an unconnected
replacement, is never addressed in the transcripts
2022-12-06.

places/castle-ravenloft.title: Castle Ravenloft
places/castle-ravenloft.content:
Strahd von Zarovich’s castle, perched on cliffs overlooking Village of Barovia. The party enters
once, for a dinner invitation, and never leaves again for the rest of the recorded campaign — all six
subsequent sessions take place somewhere inside it.
Summary
Twin guardhouses and a 50-foot precipice guard a drawbridge; the massive main doors open on their own as
organ music drifts out. Inside, the castle is riddled with illusions, traps, and the preserved history of
Strahd’s family: a dining hall, a secret puppet room, a rotting cell corridor, a cauldron room, Strahd’s
personal chamber, a flooded lower dungeon, a spire-top prison cell, catacombs full of family crypts,
Strahd’s own coffin room, a golem-guarded puzzle chamber, and a tower topped with a pulsing red glass
“heart” that is never reached in the recorded sessions.
History

The party disembarks from a mysterious black carriage into the castle’s stormy courtyard; the doors
open on their own as the session ends
2022-12-06 @ 04:16:54–04:34:13.
Dinner with Strahd turns into a castle-wide lockdown after a thrown dinner roll;
the party finds a decoy mannequin, fights skeletons, finds the Tome of Strahd, and falls into a
flooded dungeon level 2022-12-18.
A poison-gas trap in the flooded basement is set ablaze and burns for most of a session; the party meets
Bartholomew and claims the Sun Sword’s blade (then unidentified) from the fire
2022-12-26.
A ghost ambush carries the party to a spire-top prison; below, the catacombs yield the deaths of
Sasha Ivliskova and Petrina Velikovna, and Donnie’s character is turned into a vampire
thrall near Strahd’s coffin 2023-01-30.
Strahd’s coffin is found empty, and the party is teleported into a brutal boss fight with Strahd himself
in his audience chamber 2023-02-12.
A riddle-trapped gargoyle room animates two iron golems, nearly killing Alumbra
2023-03-12.
Donovan is revealed as a traitor and defeated, then accidentally flung into the Astral Plane; a
servants’ dining hall ambush by ~400 ghosts nearly wipes the party
2023-03-18.
The party’s exploration halts mid-dungeon, near a tower with a pulsing red glass “heart,” when the
session’s battle map breaks — the last recorded session of the campaign
2023-03-18.

Unresolved
The castle is never fully mapped or cleared in the recorded sessions; the tower with the red glass heart
remains unexplored.

places/council-chambers-(turgeth).title: Council Chambers (Turgeth)
places/council-chambers-(turgeth).content:
Regal domed hall in Turgeth where the Council’s seven members work; records kept by Loren Fenn.
Adjoins The Holding Cells (Turgeth).
History

The party teleports in and is logged by Loren Fenn before being cleared to interrogate the prisoner
2025-03-31 @ 00:11:35-00:14:20.

places/dockside-warehouse-(turgeth).title: Dockside Warehouse (Turgeth)
places/dockside-warehouse-(turgeth).content:
The Boot’s dockside shipping and drug operation on Turgeth’s west side.
History

The party teleports in to raid it 2025-03-31 @ 00:42:21.
Site of the full firefight against Dex and the warehouse guards, including Fugly (nicknamed
“the captain” mid-fight — see The Guard Captain) 2025-03-31
@ 01:05:14-02:48:42.
Burned down by Ozone as the party retreats 2025-03-31 @ 03:13:57-03:14:24.

places/godoy.title: Godoy
places/godoy.content:
A multicultural, changeling-populated city near the Troll Mountains, destroyed in episode 4 when the
Dyson Dynamo mirrored the party’s own fire spell across the whole city — roughly 90% mortality. An
inner Capitol district survived under a magical “blue dome.”
History

Site of the doppelganger caravan ambush that triggers the Dynamo’s citywide firestorm
2023-10-15 @ 00:56:37–01:42:41.
Confirmed roughly 90% mortality; only the party and the capital’s defenders under the blue dome survive
@ 01:42:41–01:42:50, @ 02:06:44–02:06:49.
The party watches it burn from the walls the morning after, then flees with the refugee column toward
Lutathal 2023-10-24 @ 00:12:40–00:29:12.

Unresolved
May be the same city as Lidurithal (episodes 1–2) — both sit near the Troll Mountains and both center
on the same bank — but no session states this explicitly.

places/hawthorne-college.title: Hawthorne College
places/hawthorne-college.content:
One of two top-ranked arcane schools in the world (tied with Beneth), specializing in enchantment magic,
located in the port town of Crist/Stornes. Appears only in the Pat-DM’d interlude session; see
2023-10-08 and jakedm Unresolved.
History

Alma mater and current workplace of Jace Gandolfini and Sarkhan Vol; tied with Beneth as the
top-ranked arcane college, specializing in enchantment, located in the port town of Crist/Stornes
2023-10-08 @ 00:35:02–00:35:46, @ 00:44:02.
Hosts a faculty meeting covering budget, the Elven Academy exchange, and a Changeling War update
@ 01:12:45.
Its concealed crafting workshop, password-locked in Celestial, is where Jace and Sarkhan prepare
bottles of air for the Isle of Death expedition @ 02:35:45–03:10:40.

places/howling-hooters.title: Howling Hooters
places/howling-hooters.content:
A bar/inn in Lidurithal, the party’s base for the bank job and Mary’s residence.
History

The party’s contact point; Mary’s room is upstairs
2023-09-12 @ 02:18:49–02:46:26.
Four city guards raid the bar searching for Mary and are talked out of finding anyone @ 03:27:48–03:45:01.

places/isle-of-death.title: Isle of Death
places/isle-of-death.content:
A region permanently shrouded in a deadly, constitution-draining Miasmic Cloud, once home to prestigious
necromantic schools, now abandoned. The Tomb of Horrors lies at its center. Appears only in the Pat-DM’d
interlude session; see 2023-10-08 and
jakedm Unresolved.
History

Described as once home to prestigious necromantic schools, abandoned after the miasma spread
2023-10-08 @ 00:31:05.
Confirmed via the dispelled Tomb of Horrors map to hold the Tomb at its center
2023-10-08 @ 02:01:41–02:09:52.
Prompts Jace Gandolfini and Sarkhan Vol to craft/buy bottles of air and a scroll of Concealed
Breath to survive its miasma @ 02:35:45–03:10:40.

Unresolved
No later session revisits the Isle of Death or the Tomb of Horrors expedition.

places/lidurithal.title: Lidurithal
places/lidurithal.content:
A sprawling city near the Troll Mountains with a dwarvenish, vaguely feudal-Japanese architectural
feel (sliding doors, high porches). Site of the bank job in episodes 1–2.
History

The party arrives via Mitch Copperhead’s drop-off; established as near the Troll Mountains with
dwarven/feudal-Japanese architecture 2023-09-12
@ 02:33:04, @ 02:33:25.
Home to the Howling Hooters and the unnamed bank targeted by the heist @ 02:18:49, @ 03:01:14.

Unresolved
May be the same city as Godoy (episode 4) — both sit near the Troll Mountains and both center on the
same bank — but no session states this explicitly; the name simply changes between episodes 1–2 and
episode 4.

places/lutathal.title: Lutathal
places/lutathal.content:
A city built into a mountain face in a half-oval shape with a waterfall through the wall, multicultural
and class-divided, home to the annual Magic Carpet Race (called the Rug Mandela in episode 6). Reached by
the party roughly twelve hours’ flight (or 2.5 days’ march) from Godoy.
History

Chosen as the party’s refugee destination over Ukendafar and Olingad; reached ahead of the refugee
column via flight; built in a half-oval against a mountain wall with a waterfall down it
2023-10-24 @ 00:26:13–01:17:11, @ 01:21:36.
Gate guards share a sigil with Cadillac’s mage group, tying his faction to the city @ 01:25:59.
The party registers for the Magic Carpet Race (ticket #7, 50,000 gp prize) and falls out with carpet
sponsor Greg @ 02:28:58–02:53:46.
As “Liduriel”/“Kalooza”: the rug-shop/Greg conflict continues directly from the prior session; the
party learns the race (now called the Rug Mandela, 20,000 gold winner-take-all) starts the next morning
2023-11-28 @ 00:12:38, @ 02:06:28,
@ 01:33:40.

Unresolved
The city’s name changes between “Lutathal” (episode 5) and “Liduriel”/“Kalooza” (episode 6), and the
race’s name and prize amount also change (Magic Carpet Race/50,000 gp vs. Rug Mandela/20,000 gp); no
session explicitly confirms these are the same event, though the carried-over Greg/rug-shop conflict
strongly implies the same city.

places/neo.title: Neo
places/neo.content:
A small, populous river town on Nutty’s home continent, in a country given variously as “Gaethier,”
“Manhee,” “Mannhai,” or “Man High” across sessions — likely all the same mishearing. Heavily
Asian-inspired, with many catfolk residents. Home to Star Iron Works, a custom dwarven blacksmith, a
bait-and-tackle shop, a general store, and a Church of St. Cuthbert branch.
History

Donnie and Jake fly here on a magic broom and find an enchantress willing to bind an air elemental to
the ship 2020-01-20 @ 02:04:40–02:19:25.
The party returns to shop and is nearly exposed as harboring Mori Yoshinari, wanted by the Church of
St. Cuthbert 2020-01-28 @ 00:52:22–01:15:30.

Unresolved
The spelling of the surrounding country’s name is never pinned down in the transcripts.

places/the-holding-cells-(turgeth).title: The Holding Cells (Turgeth)
places/the-holding-cells-(turgeth).content:
Prison in Turgeth holding the city’s worst criminals, including Riggs’s Widow.
History

Ozone flirts information out of Riggs’s Widow here 2025-03-31 @ 00:14:45.

places/the-inspectors'-office.title: The Inspectors' Office
places/the-inspectors'-office.content:
The inspectors’ headquarters in Turgeth, where Jerry operates the teleporter.
History

The party regroups here after the prisoner’s capture, choosing between the boot and the aqueducts job
2025-03-31 @ 00:00:00.

places/the-nexus.title: The Nexus
places/the-nexus.content:
A planar prison for powerful evil beings, conceptually similar to Carceri but run by a separate authority.
Cannot be left by plane shift — the only way out is forward, through a chain of gem-keyed portals. The
party is trapped here at the end of the recorded sessions.
History

The party steps through a one-way portal from the cult complex and arrives on a frozen, blizzard-swept
mountaintop within the Nexus 2021-10-19 @ 03:08:00.
Identified via a knowledge check, boosted by ambient knowledge the party seems to absorb just from being
there 2021-11-02 @ 00:18:18–00:19:54.
Confirmed the party cannot plane shift or backtrack out; they must advance through a chain of
gem-keyed portals, tracked by the Locate Portal Sextant
2021-11-02 @ 02:03:53–02:30:02.
An angelic-inscribed circle near the arrival portal names several other regions of (or connected to) the
Nexus: floating islands, a sunken location, a mountain range, “the scorch,” an ocean of storms, “the
twisting,” a jungle of secrets, “the empty quarter,” and ivory walls
2021-11-02 @ 02:33:53.

Unresolved
The campaign’s recorded sessions end with the party still trapped in the Nexus, resting before pushing
toward a suspected fiery plane next.

places/the-ship.title: The Ship
places/the-ship.content:
The party’s vessel through most of Arc I: originally The Mage’s trapped, blood-draining planeshifting
ship, stolen by the party, later enchanted to fly via a permanently bound air elemental, Pop Jack.
History

Originally the mage’s trapped vessel, drains blood to power its plane-shift crystal and fuel his
immortality 2020-01-20 @ 00:17:25.
The party refuels its empty blood reservoir with a captured intruder
2020-01-20 @ 01:42:47.
Permanently enchanted to fly via a bound air elemental (Pop Jack) for 100,000 gold
2020-01-20 @ 02:18:13–02:44:38.
Its planar crystal activates on its own overnight, dragging the ship into the first layer of the Abyss
2020-01-28 @ 03:40:30–03:45:48.
Refueled with drow blood after an ambush in Hell
2020-03-25 @ 00:55:49.
Jumped out of Hell via the sextant’s reset settings, landing the party in the Feywild instead of home
2020-03-25 @ 02:31:40–02:36:13.
By this point kept permanently parked thirty feet up “to dodge time wizards”
2020-04-13 @ 01:01:11.

places/turgeth.title: Turgeth
places/turgeth.content:
The city the DungeonVice party works as inspectors for, governed by a Council of seven members who keep
meticulous, timestamped records of all visitors. Home to The Inspectors’ Office, the
Council Chambers (Turgeth), and a branch of the College of Turgeth. Its drug trade was run by
Riggs and is now run by The Boot.
History

Established as governed by a Council of seven, with records kept by Loren Fenn
2025-03-31 @ 00:11:58.
The city’s teleporter network can’t reach every location — only direct hubs like headquarters and the
Council/church are reachable, and everyone can tell where a teleport originated
2025-03-31 @ 00:11:02.
Has its own sports culture: “mages and bases,” dragons and footy, handball, and ping pong (the
most-watched and bet-on sport, played by ungifted “normies”)
2025-03-31 @ 00:34:05-00:34:57.

places/village-of-barovia.title: Village of Barovia
places/village-of-barovia.content:
A fog-bound, vampire-terrorized town at the foot of Castle Ravenloft: shuttered shops, claw-scarred
walls, a church, Bildrith’s Mercantile, and the Blood of the Vine tavern. Reached through magical mists
that trap anyone without a gypsy guide and their special candles/lanterns.
History

The party arrives after forcing a goblin guide through the mists, finding a dead villager with a forged
letter on the way 2022-12-06 @ 02:09:38, @ 01:58:10.
The village’s sole remaining priest maintains the church’s holy wards through constant prayer and gives
the party a map to Castle Ravenloft 2022-12-06 @ 02:18:39.
The party meets Ismark Indirovich and Irina Indirovich at the Indirovich estate, and is ordered
off the property 2022-12-06 @ 02:32:48–03:07:21.
The party shelters overnight in the village church, watching harmless ghosts march toward the castle at
midnight 2022-12-06 @ 03:24:44.
At a nearby gypsy encampment, Madame Eva gives the party a tarot reading
2022-12-06 @ 03:44:15–03:52:28.

Unresolved
The party never returns to the village after departing for Castle Ravenloft; its fate, and that of
Ismark and Irina, is never followed up on.

quests/aqueducts-assignment.title: Aqueducts Assignment
quests/aqueducts-assignment.content:
A Council job offered by Volto, concerning funding from “Captain Lieutenant Squats.” Passed over by
the party in favor of the Hunt for the Boot.
History

Offered at the top of the session; the party chose to chase the boot instead
2025-03-31 @ 00:07:25-00:07:44.

quests/college-of-turgeth-drug-pipeline.title: College of Turgeth Drug Pipeline
quests/college-of-turgeth-drug-pipeline.content:
Investigate the College of Turgeth’s secret role as the true supplier of the drug Maka, worth
~75,000 gp/week.
History

Revealed by Riggs’s Widow during her interrogation; not yet investigated directly by the party
2025-03-31 @ 00:24:08-00:24:19.

quests/cover-up-godoy's-destruction.title: Cover Up Godoy's Destruction
quests/cover-up-godoy's-destruction.content:
After accidentally leveling Godoy (roughly 90% mortality) with their own fire magic amplified by the
Dyson Dynamo, the party debates how to avoid being blamed.
History

Connor proposes blaming an unknown natural disaster/meteor; the party sets up a refugee triage camp
partly to avoid suspicion 2023-10-15 @ 01:39:56, @ 01:49:39.

2022-12-06 @ 01:10:22.

2022-12-18 @ 01:00:01–01:00:10.

2021-11-02 @ 02:03:53.

2021-11-02 @ 02:03:16–02:19:12.

Open — this is the last recorded session; the party rests before pushing onward, with the outcome

sessions/2019-10-15-the-gang-completes-t.title: The Gang Completes the Tests of the Pharaoh
sessions/2019-10-15-the-gang-completes-t.content:
Recap
The party pushes through the pyramid’s “Tests of the Pharaoh”: a twin-door corridor warning of “the doom
of power and evil from a heartless man,” a clay golem that splits when cut (destroyed by shoving both
copies into a water channel), and a wall-of-fire trap on a water-channel staircase. Rich is swept away
alone underwater and meets a sphinx-like creature, Andrew, who offers knowledge for a solved riddle;
Rich stalls and leaves without answering. The party finds an illusory stone wall hiding the way on, then
is ambushed by five shadow “Nega” doubles of themselves. Beyond them sits The Seated Man, apparent
source of the visions that drew the party here — he wakes hostile when Rich tries to steal his staff, and
the session ends mid-fight, badly wounded, as Jake has to leave. The party reaches level 9.
Key events

Twin locked doors inscribed with a warning open onto a clay golem guardian; splitting it only
multiplies it, so it’s shoved into the water channel instead
2019-10-15 @ 00:41:26.
Rich triggers a wall-of-fire trap, dives underwater to bypass it, and is swept alone into a hidden
chamber where he meets Andrew @ 01:13:40.
The party finds an illusory stone wall (wrong material, caught by a knowledge check) hiding the path
forward @ 01:22:11.
Five “Nega” shadow-doubles of the party manifest and attack @ 01:29:28.
The party finds The Seated Man, cobwebbed and motionless on a throne, holding a staff @ 01:49:06.
Rich fails to steal the staff even with a fate-point reroll; the Seated Man wakes and joins the fight
@ 02:43:22.
Donnie drops to -11 HP from two Nega-Donnie crits, surviving via Resolve and fate points @ 03:04:00.
Session ends mid-fight, unwinnable that night; the party levels to 9 @ 03:11:36.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Andrew, The Seated Man, The Negas, clay golems
Places: The Pyramid / Tests of the Pharaoh, the twin-door corridor, the water-channel staircase hall,
the hidden underwater chamber, the illusory stone wall, the boss chamber
PCs: see the-gang for the Arc I roster

Unresolved
Whether the Seated Man is definitively the source of the visions that drew the party to the temple is
implied but never explicitly confirmed in dialogue @ 01:49:37.

sessions/2020-01-20-the-gang-loots-the-w.title: The Gang Loots the Wizard's Planeshifting Ship
sessions/2020-01-20-the-gang-loots-the-w.content:
Recap
Having killed The Mage who ran the trapped, blood-draining dream-ship, the party loots it: a
Ring of the Hive Mind off a captured intruder, and a planar crystal and Planar Sextant in the
helm room. Experimenting with the sextant, Donnie touches the crystal directly and the party is
plane-shifted, violently materializing out of a travelers’ bag of holding and killing them. Stranded
near the town of Neo, the party refuels the ship’s blood reservoir with the captured intruder, then has
a Neo enchantress permanently bind a captured air elemental to the ship for flight — the elemental later
named “Pop Jack” — making Donnie its bonded “Captain.”
Key events

Jake takes a magical signet ring off an unconscious intruder; Nutty IDs it as the [[Ring of the Hive
Mind]] on a natural 20 @ 00:04:19.
The party finds the ship’s helm-room crystal (plane shift magic) and a touch-activated
Planar Sextant @ 00:17:25–00:33:43.
Donnie touches the crystal directly; the party is plane-shifted and crushes three travelers emerging
from their bag of holding @ 01:02:51–01:11:29.
The ship’s blood reservoir is found empty; the party bleeds the captured intruder to refuel it, killing
him @ 01:42:47–01:43:35.
An elderly enchantress in Neo permanently binds a captured air elemental to the ship for 100,000 gold,
granting it flight @ 02:18:13–02:44:38.
Donnie speaks the command word “Pop Jack,” bonding with the elemental; the party elects him Captain
@ 02:33:57–02:40:23.
The ship flies to a capital port city to resupply; session ends on a shopping list
@ 03:07:17.

Entities referenced

NPCs: The Mage, the unnamed intruder, the Neo enchantress, Pop Jack
Places: the ship, Kinsess, Neo, the unnamed capital city
Items: Ring of the Hive Mind, Planar Sextant, Ring of Protection +1
PCs: Mori Yoshinari (Donnie), Dread Pirate Bobbert (Rich)

Unresolved
The country’s name is given variously as “Gaethier,” “Manhee,” “Mannhai,” and “Man High” across sessions
— likely the same mishearing, not resolved to one spelling.

sessions/2020-01-28-the-gang-goes-to-the.title: The Gang Goes to the Abyss
sessions/2020-01-28-the-gang-goes-to-the.content:
Recap
In Neo, Mori Yoshinari is nearly exposed as wanted by the Church of St. Cuthbert; the party
intimidates a priest into silence, upgrades gear, and picks up a new bard, Kurt Furbane, who talks
his way onto the crew. Scrying the paladin hunting Mori leads the party to a continent, Soyen-Suenth,
sealed inside a flesh-dissolving green barrier. Unable to breach it, they visit the isolated village of
Mishan, whose population survives on an artifact potato sack Pat (OOC) reveals he planted there — and
decline to take it. That night the ship’s planar crystal activates on its own, yanking the party into the
first layer of the Abyss, cliffhanging as a bone-and-soul demon ship turns toward them.
Key events

Beggars tip off Church of St. Cuthbert agents watching for Mori Yoshinari; the party interrogates
and silences the local priest @ 01:07:45–01:15:30.
Donnie commissions mithril +3 armor and an enchanted katana; Jake has his crystal ball enchanted with
true seeing @ 01:24:28–01:36:27.
Kurt Furbane teleports aboard the ship and charms his way into joining the crew @ 01:58:04–02:10:34.
Scrying finds the paladin hunting Mori studying a map marked over the Isle of Death @ 02:29:42.
The party finds the Soyen-Suenth continent sealed in a barrier that disintegrates flesh on contact
@ 02:42:06–02:47:33.
The village of Mishan survives on an artifact potato sack; Pat (OOC) reveals he planted it there a
year earlier; the party declines to take it @ 03:04:03–03:31:02.
That night the ship’s planar crystal hums and activates unprompted, dragging the ship into the first
layer of the Abyss @ 03:40:30–03:45:48.
Session ends on a cliffhanger as a demon-crewed bone ship turns toward the party @ 04:06:04.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Kurt Furbane, the paladin hunting Mori, the Church of St. Cuthbert priest
Places: Neo, Soyen-Suenth / the Isle of Death, Mishan, the Abyss (first layer)
Items: crystal ball (true seeing), Planar Sextant, the potato sack artifact
Quests: Church of St. Cuthbert manhunt for Mori Yoshinari (dangling); the green death bubble
(dangling)

Unresolved
Place names (Neo, Mogoki/Mugoki, Mishan/Meshun, the paladin’s name) are Whisper transcriptions of
invented fantasy names and may be misspelled.

sessions/2020-03-16-the-gang-gets-an-apo.title: The Gang Gets an Apocalypse Box
sessions/2020-03-16-the-gang-gets-an-apo.content:
Recap
Exploring “Spider Heaven,” the party finds three portal-paintings and dives through the “whimsy wall”
one, triggering d1000 random-effect rolls. Ozan’s near-max roll conjures the Apocalypse Box into his
hands; Jake fails a will save and is magically compelled to seize and guard it, including by force. Ozan
explains its powers before letting Jake keep it. Testing the box nearly summons six Shoggoths twice
before the party burns three fate points to pull a bottle of scotch instead. Donnie reveals the box can
only be destroyed by the bearer surviving three of its monster-waves and then tricking a gold dragon into
crushing it. The party levels to 11 and defers the problem.
Key events

Three portal-paintings found in a demon-lair room: a jail cell, a bar, and a “whimsy wall”
@ 00:05:19.
The party dives through the whimsy wall; d1000 rolls grant Jake +2 Int, a reroll, and a one-time
commune-with-a-deity ability, and Donnie three languages @ 00:13:21–00:16:16.
Ozan’s roll conjures the Apocalypse Box into his hands @ 00:18:15–00:20:36.
Jake fails a DC 30 will save, is compelled to seize the box from Ozan by force, and succeeds
@ 00:22:04–00:27:47.
Ozan identifies the box and explains its powers before ceding it to Jake @ 00:28:35–00:30:11.
Two rerolled box-openings nearly summon six Shoggoths each before a third reroll produces a bottle of
scotch instead @ 00:41:19–00:43:48.
Donnie explains the box can only be destroyed via three survived monster-waves and a gold dragon
crushing it (killing the dragon too) @ 00:44:54–00:46:14.
The party levels to 11; Jake hides the box in his hat @ 00:51:30–00:54:19.

Entities referenced

Items: Apocalypse Box, six Shoggoths (temporary), bottle of scotch
Places: Spider Heaven / Spider Hell, the ship
Quests: Destroy/contain the Apocalypse Box (started, dangling)

Unresolved
The exact mapping of individual d1000 rolls to which player got which Whimsy Wall reward is garbled by
crosstalk and could be swapped.

sessions/2020-03-24-the-gang-witnesses-d.title: The Gang Witnesses Demon Nutty Killing Ozan
sessions/2020-03-24-the-gang-witnesses-d.content:
Recap
With no clean fix for the Apocalypse Box’s curse on Jake (now called Tick-Tick), the party drains
their own blood to refuel the ship and plans to flee to Earth, leaving Tick-Tick behind. While Ozan
manually pumps Tick-Tick’s heart after a near-fatal bleed, an invisible attacker — a demon that has
secretly possessed Nutty’s body since he touched a cursed soul gem sessions earlier — kills Ozan outright,
then kills the unconscious Tick-Tick. With his dying breath Tick-Tick communes with Pelor and is reborn a
Paladin, lifting the box’s curse; he banishes the demon, freeing Nutty. The session ends with Ozan dead
(True Resurrection planned) and the box’s threat resolved.
Key events

The party rules out polymorphing Tick-Tick to dodge the box’s compulsion; it’s tied to his true form
@ 00:34:00.
The party drains its own blood to refuel the ship; Tick-Tick loses 40%+ blood volume and goes into
cardiac arrest @ 00:50:11–00:59:00.
Rich and Donovan find six masked drow digging up a treasure chest in Lolth’s dungeon and talk them into
following the party back to the ship instead of fighting @ 01:43:02–01:47:26.
An invisible attacker kills Ozan’s character outright while he tends to Tick-Tick @ 01:52:40–01:59:28.
The same attacker kills the unconscious Tick-Tick @ 02:19:00–02:22:31.
Dying, Tick-Tick communes with Pelor; his body dissolves and reforms as a Paladin of Pelor, lifting the
box’s curse @ 02:22:10–02:39:50.
The reborn Paladin banishes the demon possessing Nutty with his holy symbol @ 02:42:10.
Nutty wakes disoriented; the soul gem that caused his possession cannot be found afterward @ 02:50:25.
The party agrees to pursue a 25,000gp True Resurrection for Ozan @ 03:17:36.

Entities referenced

NPCs: the demon in Nutty, six masked drow, Pelor, Lolth
PCs: Tick-Tick (dies and is reborn this session), Ozan’s character (dies this session)
Items: Apocalypse Box (curse lifted), the soul gem
Quests: Apocalypse Box curse (resolved), the demon-possessed soul gem (resolved), True Resurrection for
Ozan (started)

Unresolved
Whether the party ever recovers the soul gem is left open — the search of Nutty’s belongings came up
empty.

sessions/2020-03-25-the-gang-gets-outta-.title: The Gang Gets Outta Hell
sessions/2020-03-25-the-gang-gets-outta-.content:
Recap
Still in Hell, the party mass-suggests the drow following them into a trap, restores Nutty’s soul from
its gem, and loots the subdued drow. Rich is teleported alone into a puzzle room and nearly killed by a
soul-sucking demon before Jake and Donnie arrive; the demon is killed and a petrifying basilisk-guardian
statue is freed and dies. Rather than finish the half-solved dungeon, the party flees via the ship’s
interplanar jump — and lands not on the Material Plane but in the Feywild, where a sentient river asks to
speak to Jake. Ozan’s disembodied soul fails to rejoin his destroyed body.
Key events

Rich casts Mass Suggestion on the pursuing drow group, sending them into a trap @ 00:34:50–00:35:39.
Rich recovers the soul gem and restores Nutty’s soul to his body @ 00:42:10–00:44:47.
The party loots the drow (Boots of Blinding Speed, Amulets of Natural Armor, a Cloak of Resistance +3,
a keen longsword) @ 00:48:27–01:06:11.
Rich is teleported alone via a circular key into a puzzle room and found unconscious, being drained by
a soul-sucking demon @ 00:57:32–01:15:43.
The demon is killed after a prolonged fight; a basilisk-guardian statue pair is freed from its own gaze
via Wall of Force and dies, dropping a necklace of keys @ 01:15:43–01:34:24.
The party abandons the rest of the dungeon and has Donnie pilot an interplanar jump
@ 02:28:47–02:33:21.
The ship lands in the Feywild/First World instead of home; a sentient river asks to speak to Jake
@ 02:40:38–02:43:16.
Ozan’s disembodied soul fails to rejoin his destroyed body @ 02:49:42.

Entities referenced

NPCs: the soul-sucking demon, the armored-man/basilisk guardian, the drow group
Places: Hell/the Abyss, the secret puzzle room, the Feywild/First World
Items: soul gem (resolved), Boots of Blinding Speed, necklace of keys
Quests: Escape Hell (completed this session); recover/resurrect Ozan (ongoing)

Unresolved
“Atza,” named once in the recap as owner of a different soul-trapped gem and body, is never reconciled
with the rest of the session’s soul-gem plotline.

sessions/2020-04-06-the-gang-finds-a-fro.title: The Gang Finds a Frozen Elephant Man
sessions/2020-04-06-the-gang-finds-a-fro.content:
Recap
In an escalating monster-trial on an “upside-down” pocket plane, the party fights two demonic creatures
while Nutty finds a frozen Loxodon, Obadiah Jones, sealed in ice beside his dead former party. After
every indignity short of fire fails to melt the ice, Rich’s summoned fire elementals free Obadiah, who
wakes disoriented and covered in urine. Mid-fight, one demon grapples Jake, drags him into the Ethereal
Plane, and drains his Strength to 0, knocking him unconscious there — the session ends with the party
unable to reach him.
Key events

Donnie is turned to stone by a basilisk at the session’s start and remains petrified throughout
@ 00:24:06.
Two black-fleshed demons spawn the moment the basilisks die @ 00:25:17.
Nutty finds a side room with Obadiah Jones frozen in ice beside his dead former party’s skeletons
@ 00:49:11–01:57:36.
Multiple attempts to melt the ice fail (prestidigitation, feathers, urine) until Rich summons three
fire elementals @ 01:07:57–01:37:47.
Obadiah wakes, freed, confused, and covered in pee and fire elementals @ 01:45:29.
One demon grapples Jake, drags him into the Ethereal Plane, and drains his Strength to 0 over several
rounds, knocking him unconscious there @ 01:31:42–01:59:08.
The surviving demon resists repeated suggestion/mass suggestion attempts to bring Jake back
@ 02:08:31–02:10:00.
Session ends with the party still trying to figure out how to reach the Ethereal Plane
@ 02:13:51.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Obadiah Jones (joins the party), the two demons
Places: the trial dungeon / pocket plane, the ice room
Quests: Rescue Jake from the Ethereal Plane (started, unresolved this session)

Unresolved
The mechanism by which the party eventually reaches Jake in the Ethereal Plane is not shown — he is back
and active by the next session.

sessions/2020-04-13-the-gang-fights-a-ch.title: The Gang Fights a Church Demon
sessions/2020-04-13-the-gang-fights-a-ch.content:
Recap
Caring for a newborn god-baby pulled from a shrine pearl, the party flies the (now permanently airborne)
ship to a temple hosting a paladin’s knighting ceremony. Tick-Tick’s joke about “nosebleed” seating gets
him challenged to a duel. Mid-ceremony the paladin transforms into a glabrezu demon, kills the high
priest, and casts Confusion and Reverse Gravity on the crowd. The party kills the demon in a running
fight; when the spells end, the airborne, confused crowd crashes back down, killing nearly everyone else
in the temple. A voice announces Clydewell Keep has fallen as Pat ends the session; the party hits level
12.
Key events

A blank metal pendant clasps itself around the shrine-baby’s neck unprompted; detect magic shows it
radiating overwhelming divine power @ 00:41:00–00:53:34.
The party decides to raise the baby themselves as the founder of their own religion
@ 00:49:08–00:53:49.
The party talks its way into Sir Holton Albright’s knighting ceremony claiming to represent a
church of Pelor @ 01:36:34–01:41:15.
Tick-Tick is forcibly thrown out over a “nosebleeds” joke and challenged to a duel to the death the next
sunrise @ 01:43:28–01:46:49.
Mid-anointing, Sir Holton transforms into a glabrezu demon, instantly kills the high priest, and casts
Confusion and Reverse Gravity on the crowd @ 01:52:04–02:35:32.
The party kills the demon in a running fight across the ceiling and floor; Kurt Furbank lands the
finishing blow @ 03:08:50–03:35:20.
Confusion and Reverse Gravity end simultaneously; the airborne crowd crashes down, killing nearly
everyone left in the temple @ 03:35:41.
A voice announces Clydewell Keep has fallen; the session ends and the party reaches level 12
@ 03:36:47–03:40:42.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Sir Holton Albright, the high priest, the offended knight
Places: the flooded shrine, Clydewell Keep, the temple
Items: the god-baby’s pendant
Quests: raising the god-baby (started); Jake’s duel to the death (started, interrupted); Clydewell
Keep’s fall (new hook, unresolved); the miasma crisis (ongoing, no progress this session)

Unresolved
Whether “Kurt Furbank,” here played by Nutty, is the same character as Kurt Furbane, Ozan’s bard
introduced in an earlier session, is not reconciled — see that page’s Unresolved section.

sessions/2020-09-28-ozandm-the-gang-does.title: The Gang Does a Kidnap Job
sessions/2020-09-28-ozandm-the-gang-does.content:
Recap
A one-shot interlude DM’d by Ozan (Pat plays a PC this time). Disguised with Pat’s elixirs, the party
infiltrates a mansion banquet to kidnap a goblin, Littlepen, who’s attending as a guest of the
Aspis Corporation. A guard sweep for an unregistered goblin nearly blows the operation; Pat distracts
with a self-inflicted wound and an Alchemist’s Fire, poisoned soup sickens half the banquet, and under
cover of darkness the party beats Littlepen unconscious and flees through a jungle gauntlet, outrunning
pursuing guards. The job succeeds, though no one remembers the payment.
Key events

Guards sweep for an unregistered goblin, rounding up Littlepen and the disguised Donnie
@ 00:17:30.
Pat deliberately wounds himself and ignites Alchemist’s Fire to cause chaos and cover an escape attempt
@ 00:29:52–00:57:00.
The party’s poisoned soup sickens roughly half the banquet, including Littlepen
@ 01:26:38–01:27:17.
Rich’s Darkness spell blacks out the stage; Nutty and Donnie move in on the hallucinating Littlepen
@ 01:31:05–02:12:04.
Jake knocks Littlepen fully unconscious and carries him out @ 02:19:45–02:20:27.
The party flees through a jungle obstacle course chased by guards; a critical Sleep spell frees Jake
from a last grapple @ 02:47:52–03:11:14.
The party boards its getaway boat with Littlepen secured and reaches level 5 @ 03:19:14–03:22:03.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Littlepen, the Aspis Corporation guard, the mansion’s guard captain
Factions: Aspis Corporation
Places: the mansion/banquet hall, the jungle, the river getaway
Quests: Kidnap Littlepen (completed); payment for the job (dangling, no one remembers the sum)

Unresolved
Whether this one-shot connects to the main Arc I or Arc II storyline is never addressed; see
the-gang.

sessions/2021-10-19-the-gang-answers-thr.title: The Gang Answers Three Riddles
sessions/2021-10-19-the-gang-answers-thr.content:
Recap
Deep in a cult’s abandoned underground complex, the party finds evidence of a heart-stealing ritual tied
to an incoming “new lord,” Brother Felhorn. A living Sphinx Painting demands three riddles be
answered to pass, zapping failed guesses with lightning before the party gets all three right. Beyond it,
a Nexus-portal device lets Alexander scout a frozen plane with ice golems and a frost giant. After
resting, having their aging curses lifted, and gearing up, the party (minus Donnie and Ozan, who stay
behind with the now-sentient Sphinx) steps through the one-way portal — arriving face-to-face with the
frost giant on a cliffhanger.
Key events

The party finds cultist quarters, desiccated heart-removed bodies, and a note naming a ritual gathering
to welcome “Brother Felhorn” @ 00:07:22–00:18:33.
A living Sphinx Painting demands three riddles to pass a secret door, lightning-zapping wrong
guesses @ 00:27:24–00:58:56.
All three riddles are answered correctly (the letter N; sawdust; time), with heavy damage taken along
the way @ 00:41:50–00:58:02.
The floor teleports the party into a new sealed complex with a Nexus-portal device
@ 00:58:56–01:08:00.
Alexander scouts the portal’s destination remotely via his Psycrystal: a frozen plane with ice
golems, a frost giant, and treasure @ 01:08:00–01:17:35.
The party rests in town, has aging curses lifted for free by a church of Abadar, and gears up for cold
weather @ 02:34:30–02:55:44.
The party (minus Donnie and Ozan, who remain with the Sphinx) steps through the one-way portal and
arrives on the frozen plane facing the frost giant and ice golems @ 03:08:00.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Sphinx Painting, Brother Felhorn (unseen), the church priest/janitor
Factions: Grimson Knights
Items: the ship’s… — see Locate Portal Sextant, Psycrystal, Ember (sword)
Quests: discover what’s through the Nexus portal network (progressed); complete the seven-jewel
locate-portal sextant (started)

Unresolved
Whether the painting is “the Sphinx” or “the Phoenix” is used inconsistently in the transcript; treated
here as one entity, the Sphinx.

sessions/2021-11-02-the-gang-teleports-a.title: The Gang Teleports Away a Frost Giant
sessions/2021-11-02-the-gang-teleports-a.content:
Recap
Mid-teleport onto a blizzard-swept mountaintop, the party (Donnie absent, his character Fish piloted
by Rich) faces a frost giant and four golem escorts with a sheer cliff at their backs. Alexander’s
dislocator gun repeatedly teleports the golems away one at a time while the rest of the party burns them
down; the giant flees on foot. A knowledge check reveals the party is in the Nexus, a planar prison they
cannot plane-shift out of — the only way forward is through a chain of gem-keyed portals. After looting
three treasure chests (including a mimic disguised as a sword), the party rests, newly self-declared
“champions of the North,” with a new gem suggesting a fiery plane next.
Key events

The party arrives mid-teleport on a mountaintop facing a frost giant and four golems, with a sheer
120-ft cliff behind them @ 00:00:29–00:16:06.
A knowledge check reveals the plane is “the Nexus,” a prison for powerful evil beings akin to Carceri
but under separate management @ 00:18:18–00:19:54.
Alexander’s dislocator gun “Becky” teleports golems dozens of miles away one at a time, removing
them from the fight @ 00:20:53–01:16:00.
The main giant flees on foot after being hit with Jake’s dislocator and the party’s damage
@ 01:19:19.
The party loots three treasure chests (~50,000 gold in gems) and several joke/magic items; one “sword”
turns out to be a mimic, eventually killed after being greased, laughter-stunned, and lassoed off a
cliff @ 01:20:01–01:59:23.
The party confirms the sextant can’t get them back out — they must advance through a chain of linked
portals @ 02:30:02.
Session ends with the party resting before pushing toward a suspected fiery plane next
@ 02:36:29.

Entities referenced

NPCs: the frost giant, the mimic
Places: The Nexus, the frigid mountaintop battlefield
Items: Locate Portal Sextant, Becky (dislocator gun), assorted Nexus loot (hat of Steve, dagger of
the poet, inverse umbrella)
Quests: escape the Nexus (started, open at session’s end — the last recorded session)

Unresolved
The main antagonist is called a “frost giant” throughout the fight but a “storm giant” once by Pat
afterward — unclear if this is a slip or a deliberate detail.

sessions/2022-12-06-the-gang-goes-to-rav.title: The Gang Goes to Ravenloft (1)
sessions/2022-12-06-the-gang-goes-to-rav.content:
Recap
The party gathered at a goblin-run roadside inn, where two robed strangers checked in and left everyone
unsettled @ 00:25:34–00:33:28. That night the whole party shared a prophetic nightmare of a vampire, a
crying letter-writer, and a storm-wreathed castle @ 00:54:14. The next morning a letter arrived, signed by
Kolyan Indirovich, Burgomaster of Barovia, pleading for help for his bitten daughter — alongside an
unrelated dinner invitation from “the Baron” that led to the same place @ 01:07:29–01:28:52.
Forcing a goblin to guide them through the enchanted mists, the party found a dead villager carrying a
forged copy of the plea letter, his wounds marked as a transformed human’s, not an animal’s
@ 01:58:10–02:02:16. In the fog-bound village of Barovia they met its sole remaining priest, who revealed
the Baron was the vampire terrorizing the land and gave them a map to Castle Ravenloft
@ 02:09:38–02:18:39. At the Blood of the Vine tavern they met Ismark Indirovich, confirmed neither
letter was his father’s real handwriting, and found his sister Irina twice-bitten by
Strahd and refusing to be restrained; the family ordered the party off their property
@ 02:32:48–03:07:21.
Sheltering overnight in the village church, the party watched harmless ghosts march toward the castle at
midnight @ 03:24:44. The next day Madame Eva gave them a tarot reading — Death, a reversed card of
conflict, and the Fool — plus a prophecy of “a tool of evil” protected by darkness @ 03:44:15–03:52:28.
Choosing to approach by daylight rather than attend the night’s dinner, the party rode a mysterious black
carriage to Castle Ravenloft, whose doors swung open on their own as organ music drifted out
@ 04:10:50–04:36:16.
Key events

A shared prophetic nightmare hits the whole party: a vampire, a crying letter-writer, a storm-wreathed
castle @ 00:54:14.
A page delivers Kolyan Indirovich’s plea for help, and the party realizes it shares directions with
an unrelated dinner invitation from “the Baron” @ 01:06:39–01:28:52.
Jake’s character forces a young goblin to guide the party through the magical mists around Barovia
@ 01:17:14.
The party finds a dead villager holding a forged copy of the plea letter, killed by what Donnie’s
character identifies (natural 20) as a transformed human, not an animal @ 01:58:10–01:59:09.
The village priest reveals the Baron is the vampire Strahd and gives the party a map to the castle
@ 02:15:24–02:18:39.
The party meets Ismark Indirovich and finds Irina bitten twice by Strahd, with
no reflection; she and Ismark refuse restraint and order the party out @ 02:52:37–03:07:21.
Ghosts rise from the churchyard at midnight and walk harmlessly toward the castle @ 03:24:44.
Madame Eva gives the party a tarot reading and a prophecy about “a tool of evil” @ 03:44:15–03:52:28.
A driverless black carriage carries the party to Castle Ravenloft, whose doors open on their own as
the session ends @ 04:12:35–04:34:13.

Entities referenced

NPCs: Strahd von Zarovich, Kolyan Indirovich, Ismark Indirovich, Irina Indirovich, the
unnamed village priest, Madame Eva
Places: the roadside goblin inn, Svalich Woods, Village of Barovia, the Indirovich estate, the
village church, the gypsy encampment, Castle Ravenloft
Items: Ion Stone, Aegis of Recovery, Scabbard of Keen Edges, the Shadow Well, the forged plea letter,
the map to Castle Ravenloft
Quests: Rescue the Burgomaster’s Family (started), Find the Tool of Evil (started)

sessions/2022-12-18-the-gang-meets-strah.title: The Gang Meets Strahd For Dinner (Ravenloft 2)
sessions/2022-12-18-the-gang-meets-strah.content:
Recap
The party entered Castle Ravenloft’s foyer to distant organ music, startled a servant hidden inside a
suit of armor, and followed the sound to a grand dining hall where a caped figure introduced himself as
their host, Strahd von Zarovich @ 00:19:27–00:42:14. Jacques threw his dinner roll
at him; Strahd vanished with a maniacal laugh, and every door slammed shut, every torch went out, and all

Tome of Strahd — hidden under his mattress @ 01:54:57–02:14:51. A trap door dropped Todd and the

A trap door drops Todd and the familiar fifty feet into a flooded dungeon level; the rest of the party

sessions/2022-12-26-the-gang-sets-fire-t.content:
Recap
Picking up in the flooded basement of Castle Ravenloft, Todd and
Ozan’s character found themselves trapped in a cell at the bottom of a hundred-foot
shaft, across from cells stuffed with gold and silver @ 00:34:37–00:38:55. While looting it, a hidden
mechanism flooded a nearby cell with poison gas; Nutty threw a lit torch in to test if it was flammable —

Todd and Ozan’s character are trapped at the bottom of a hundred-foot funnel shaft, across from

The party recovers 630 gold and nearly 5,000 silver, triggering an electrified gate @ 01:11:45–01:13:20.
